tokens.name: mastercard-red
tokens.usage: The left circle of the Mastercard mark — used only in the brand logo, never as a UI color.

tokens.name: mastercard-yellow
tokens.usage: The right circle of the Mastercard mark — used only in the brand logo, never as a UI color.

tokens.name: ink-black
tokens.usage: The warm near-black used for primary CTAs, headline text on cream, and the footer surface. Slightly warm (the `13` blue value pulls toward the cream) so it never feels jet-black on the warm canvas.

tokens.name: signal-orange
tokens.usage: The burnt/rust CTA orange used on consent actions and eyebrow dots. Deeper than the brand yellow, brighter than ink — it's the page's single aggressive color and must be used sparingly.

tokens.name: light-signal-orange
tokens.usage: A lighter carroty orange used for carousel active indicators and decorative orbital arcs. Always acts as an attention cue, never as body color.

tokens.name: clay-brown
tokens.usage: The deep rust used for secondary link-style buttons (e.g., cookie details). Sits between ink and signal orange.

tokens.name: canvas-cream
tokens.usage: The page canvas. Warm, putty-toned, the default body background. All editorial sections sit on this.

tokens.name: lifted-cream
tokens.usage: One step lighter than canvas — used for nested "raised" sections that want to feel like paper laid on paper.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Reserved for the floating navigation pill, modal cards, secondary button fills, and small satellite-CTA circles attached to image portraits.

tokens.name: soft-bone
tokens.usage: A cool-gray alternative surface used inside a handful of component subregions.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: A slightly softer black used for some text alternates.

tokens.name: slate-gray
tokens.usage: Muted secondary text — eyebrow label alternative, disabled states, "Privacy Choices" bottom-row text.

tokens.name: dust-taupe
tokens.usage: Very muted cream-gray used for disabled or "whisper" text (e.g., placeholder-like empty state labels). Low contrast on cream; use only for subdued content.

tokens.name: link-blue
tokens.usage: A deep, slightly dusty blue used for inline links and informational callouts. Saturated enough to read as a link without being neon.
